description: Protection-system audit and approved design await final written-spec review before TDD implementation planning.
scope: MotorcycleAntiTheftSensor authoritative protection state, Telegram commands, sensor incident pipeline, delivery reporting, Demo Mode, history, and supporting UI.
completed: Audited the current dashboard, Telegram setup, sensor diagnostics, arm/disarm lifecycle, status reporting, and alert paths.
Removed the blocking red alarm popup while retaining background alert delivery.
Kept Telegram polling alive after disarm and added local UI synchronization for remote arm-state changes.
Added pairing-code expiry renewal and a 30-second per-alert-type cooldown as interim safeguards.
Removed the stale Telegram certificate pin so Android system trust can establish the API connection.
Paired the Telegram owner successfully and confirmed remote control became enabled.
Defined and user-approved the product direction: one authoritative protection model, truthful status, correlated incidents, persistent history, and safe Demo Mode.
Defined Demo Mode to send marked Telegram messages but never SMS or emergency calls.
Wrote and committed the design specification at commit ee8e3d1.
knowledge: The existing service, UI, encrypted preferences, sensors, and Telegram client infer protection state independently; this is the primary architectural defect.
Telegram /arm currently acknowledges too early and /status reports stored values rather than verified runtime health.
Sensors currently alert independently; light uses a fixed threshold and audio is relative amplitude rather than calibrated sound pressure.
Disarmed mode must retain the foreground service and Telegram polling so remote /arm remains available.
The raw Bot Token was visible in the old UI and in discarded audit captures; retained audit images are redacted.

assumptions.assumption: The connected Android phone remains the primary deployment and demonstration target.
The existing Telegram Bot API and encrypted preference storage will be preserved during the incremental implementation.
A 10-second arming baseline is acceptable for the first implementation and can later be tuned with device evidence.

risks.risk: The previously displayed Telegram Bot Token must be considered compromised.
risks.mitigation: Revoke and regenerate it through BotFather before customer use; mask it by default in the app and never store it in screenshots, logs, tests, or checkpoints.

risks.risk: The Git worktree contains many pre-existing modified and untracked files.
risks.mitigation: Preserve all unrelated changes, use exact-path staging only, and review diffs before every commit.

risks.risk: A broad rewrite could regress the Telegram path that is currently functioning.
risks.mitigation: Implement the coordinator incrementally with TDD and retain existing transports behind narrow interfaces.

risks.risk: Current fixed sensor thresholds can create false alerts on real hardware.
risks.mitigation: Add grace-period baseline capture, debounce, freshness checks, correlation, and controlled device verification before production claims.

risks.risk: HCP auto-commit reported success even though sandbox permissions prevented writing the Git index.
risks.mitigation: Treat checkpoint usability as the deliverable; explicitly validate latest pointer, resume, audit, and recovery. Commit HCP artifacts only with exact-path approval if needed.

memory_snapshot.value: Incremental authoritative ProtectionCoordinator with SETUP_REQUIRED, DISARMED_ONLINE, ARMING, ARMED_HEALTHY, ARMED_DEGRADED, ALERT_ACTIVE, and OFFLINE.
Demo incidents use the real UI/history/Telegram path, are always marked DEMO, and cannot invoke SMS or calls.
Do not write the implementation plan or production code until the user reviews and approves the written specification.

dependencies: Fresh TDD implementation plan before production changes
BotFather token rotation before customer use

decisions.question: How should the app evolve without breaking working Telegram connectivity?
decisions.decision: Add an authoritative protection coordinator incrementally while preserving existing transports.
decisions.rationale: This minimizes regression risk and enables testable phased delivery.

decisions.question: What external effects may Demo Mode trigger?
decisions.decision: It may send clearly marked Telegram messages but must never send SMS or initiate emergency calls.
decisions.rationale: Customer demonstrations need realistic evidence without unsafe side effects.

decisions.question: What happens to remote control after disarm?
decisions.decision: Theft detectors stop, but the service and Telegram polling remain active.
decisions.rationale: The owner must be able to arm the parked phone remotely.

open_questions.question: Does the user approve the written specification without changes?
